links.outcome: LLM treatment-site identification accuracy benchmarked against two human observers
links.effect: Weighted accuracy 94.2% [95%CI: 89.4%-98.1%] versus sites isolated by either observer; 92.3% versus delivered plans.
links.quote: Llama 3.3 achieved a weighted accuracy of 94.2% [95%CI: 89.4%-98.1%] when compared to sites isolated by either observer.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and expert ratings of Llama 3.3 for extracting and summarizing radiotherapy treatment sites from retrospective patient notes, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
